title: Copilot Managing Maintenance Intake by Zig

chapters.title: Problem statement and copilot solution overview

features.name: Copilot-powered maintenance intake
features.description: A copilot solution that handles maintenance intake based on natural language, images, or a combination of both. It analyzes the input and creates a maintenance request with possible solutions for the fix.

features.name: Image-based maintenance issue analysis
features.description: Copilot can analyze images of maintenance issues to determine the problem and suggest appropriate solutions.

features.name: Maintenance request attachments and AI explanation
features.description: The system stores the image and provides an explanation of what the AI is seeing in the image when viewing the maintenance request attachments.
